name: MECH LEAGUE Boxing
summary:
Welcome to MECH LEAGUE Boxing—an adrenaline-pumping, metal-punching VR boxing experience. Step into your mech and rise through the ranks using using powerful punches, well-timed dodges, and precise counters

Feel every hit. Break a sweat. Earn your way to the top.

In a future where mech battles are the ultimate escape, robot fighting has become the arena where champions are made. Now it’s your turn.
